title: Exploring Qwik City w/ Adam Bradley & Manu Martínez-Almeida
description:
Qwik City is the new meta-framework from Builder.io, built on top of their framework Qwik. Qwik already takes a very unique approach to web applications and with the help of Adam and Manu we are going to understand what building full-stack apps looks like.
